A course module built on the shared study database. In a course project the notebooks
folder is `modules/`, and everything renders to `rendered/`.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import framework as fw
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root = fw.scaffold()
```

## The course layout

A course has folders for modules, slides, assignments, course documents, readings, and
data. `render_dirs` sends each one to its own folder under `rendered/`.

```{python}
fw.project_info()
```

```{python}
fw.settings("render_dirs")
```

## This week's data

Students query the study database through the `study` connection. Each row is one
clinic visit.

```{python}
visits = fw.db_query(
    """
    SELECT v.participant_id, v.visit_number, v.systolic_bp, v.diastolic_bp,
           p.treatment, p.age
    FROM visits v JOIN participants p USING (participant_id)
    WHERE v.systolic_bp IS NOT NULL
    """,
    "study",
)
visits.describe().round(1)
```

The extract is saved to `data/` with `data_save()` so the slides and the assignment read
the same file. The catalog name `data.week1_visits` puts it in the course's `data`
folder.

```{python}
fw.data_save(visits, "data.week1_visits", type="csv");
fw.data_list()
```

## A first look

How is systolic pressure distributed? Look for the long right tail.

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
ax.hist(visits["systolic_bp"], bins=30, color="#1f6fb2")
ax.set(xlabel="Systolic BP (mmHg)", ylabel="Visits")
plt.show()
```

The share of visits at or above 140 mmHg, by arm and visit. Discuss: why might this
fall faster in one arm?

```{python}
(
    visits.assign(high=visits["systolic_bp"] >= 140)
    .groupby(["visit_number", "treatment"])["high"].mean()
    .unstack().round(3)
)
```
